title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Rajeshwari is shocked by Vennila's strange behaviour after emerging from her room. Pavithra applies mehendi to Kanmani's hands, saying it is good during pregnancy.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi and Nalini rejoice upon receiving a bulk batter order from the supermarket. Kalamma orchestrates a power cut to obstruct Ilamathi's batter preparation.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Terrified by Divya's fake possession of Parvathy's spirit, Karna looks for ways to drive it out. Later, he falsely frames Vetri for kidnapping Mahesh and gets him arrested.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Pechi hugs Manjamalai as he accepts Mayandi's terms. Invited to the festival, Poongodi and Azhagar are welcomed at Manjamalai's house, but he refuses to speak to Poongodi.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Ragavan deliberately disturbs Lakshmi, Malar and Mathi as they enjoy a movie. Mathi and Malar are happy when Lakshmi enthusiastically tells her sons how much she enjoyed it.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Raji strongly objects to Kathir including Senthil in his travel business. Saravanan gets enraged when Gomathi deceives him into coming to the hospital for Thangamayil's check-up.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Pallavan fears future family conflicts and asks his brothers to promise they will never leave him. Das questions Nadesan about placing the family's entire responsibility on Nila.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Rohini suspects Devaki's call to Manoj and questions him about being called her son-in-law. Shruthi is annoyed by Ravi bringing children's pictures and toys into their room.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Tamizhselvi cherishes time with her two children and captures moments in photos. Elsewhere, Eshwari's costly jewellery sparks suspicion in Savithri and Thamarai.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Vyshali's dad visits Karikalan to confirm her marriage to Aadhavan. Later, Saranya warns Kamala for hitting Kasthuri over her involvement in Swetha's marriage.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Arunchalam invites Murugan and Indhira to his home for the post-wedding feast. Meanwhile, Shanmugam gets into trouble when Abhi arrives at the mess with her friends for breakfast.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 11: Power Shifts and Food War
description: What begins with a food clash, ends in an assembly revolt. A dramatic resignation and high-stakes re-election follows. Who will become the new leader?
